concerns.text: FR-001 (download integrity), FR-002 (exclude <2 ratings), Edge Case (1-2 day participants), and Edge Case (corrupted data) lack explicit implementation tasks in the main pipeline. T050-T053 are marked unimplemented in 'Phase N+1', leaving critical spec requirements without assigned work.

FR-005 requires verifying coefficient sign consistency >= 90% across LOPO folds. T028b only flags the result if < 90% but lacks a task to enforce this threshold or halt the pipeline, leaving the success criterion unverified in execution.

FR-006 requires verifying the p-value remains < 0.05 (or non-significant) in the weekdays-only sensitivity analysis. T029 returns a boolean flag but does not explicitly calculate/store the actual p-value in the final artifact, making independent verification impossible.

FR-008 requires reporting the consistency percentage for single-rating bootstrap analysis. T031c returns a pass flag but lacks a task to explicitly document the 'consistency percentage' in the final model_results.json or report, risking omission of this metric.

SC-004 and Constitution Principle VII require residual normality/homoscedasticity diagnostics (Shapiro-Wilk, Breusch-Pagan p-values). T023 generates plots but lacks a task to write the statistical test results (p-values) to the machine-readable model_results.json artifact.

Tasks T050-T053 are listed as unimplemented in a 'Phase N+1' section, but the spec defines these as mandatory constraints (e.g., 'MUST handle', 'MUST fail gracefully'). This creates a false impression that these are optional polish items rather than core requirements.
